data.title: Baroque Access Website Flow Check
data.notes:
Sahle wants two things now: full live-site testing and an annotated UI/UX audit. He does not want a new redesign or prototype yet.

Your priority should be:

Multi-option quotation for Vandana — most urgent
Use Vandana’s member account, not your own.
Create or open her request.
Build a quotation containing at least two options.
Send the quotation.
Confirm to Sahle once it has been sent.
Check that the member-side request correctly shows what you sent.
Test the live agent workflow end to end

Use the live site only: baroqueaccess.com

Test on both:

Laptop
Phone

For every failure:

Take a screenshot with the browser address bar visible.
Label it BLOCKER, MAJOR, or MINOR.
Report one clear sentence for each numbered item.

Important correction: do not change the board grouping. When you open /admin/requests, it should already show these sections where data exists:

Incoming — nobody has these
You are on
Everything else

Because there are only three requests, you may see only two sections. That is expected.

You need to test:

Whether Incoming appears first.
Whether those three sections make sense for your workflow.
Only one page heading and one search box.
No horizontal cutoff or sideways scrolling on mobile.
Red appears only for unclaimed or overdue requests.
Claiming moves the request into “You are on.”
Sending and viewing Vandana’s multi-option quotation.
Closing the request.
Creating a request on behalf of a member.
The new request appears at the top of “You are on.”
Salesforce reference appears.
Pay-hold error without a saved card.
Category filtering and board sorting.
Editing quotation options, including map and location family.
All six previously reported mobile fixes, one result per fix with the device tested.
Annotated UI/UX screenshots

Review the new:

Request board
Request record

Annotate screenshots of the real live screens and explain:

What is wrong with the layout
What has poor visual hierarchy
What information or action should be hidden
What is taking too much space
What is confusing, duplicated, misaligned, cut off, or difficult to scan

Do not focus on colours or typography because Sahle says those are already settled.

Send existing design work

He already has:

Travel Agent Dashboard
Yacht Dashboard
LUJO Figma

Send him any other member-side redesigns, mockups, concepts, or unfinished design files you already have. Do not create anything new specifically for this yet.

In short: test the live platform, send Vandana’s two-option quotation first, document every failure with evidence, then provide annotated screenshots—not a new prototype.
